<module id="edge_detect">
    <description>Detects rising and falling edges in the input signal 'a' and outputs corresponding signals 'rise' and 'down'. The output signals are synchronized with the clock signal 'clk' and remain set to 1 until the corresponding edge appears again.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock signal.</input>
        <input id="rst_n">Reset signal (active low).</input>
        <input id="a">Input signal.</input>
        <output id="rise">Output signal indicating a rising edge.</output>
        <output id="down">Output signal indicating a falling edge.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="IDLE">State representing the idle condition.</parameter>
        <parameter id="RISING_EDGE">State representing the rising edge condition.</parameter>
        <parameter id="FALLING_EDGE">State representing the falling edge condition.</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <reg id="prev_a" type="internal_signal">Previous value of input signal 'a'.</reg>
        <reg id="current_state" type="internal_signal">Current state of the edge detector.</reg>
        <reg id="next_state" type="internal_signal">Next state of the edge detector.</reg>
        
        <always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n)>
            if (~rst_n) begin
                prev_a <= 1'b0;
                current_state <= IDLE;
            end else begin
                prev_a <= a;
                current_state <= next_state;
            end
        </always>
        
        <always @(*) begin
            case(current_state)
                IDLE: begin
                    if (a == 1 && prev_a == 0) begin
                        next_state = RISING_EDGE;
                    end else if (a == 0 && prev_a == 1) begin
                        next_state = FALLING_EDGE;
                    end else begin
                        next_state = IDLE;
                    end
                end
                
                RISING_EDGE: begin
                    if (a == 1 && prev_a == 0) begin
                        next_state = RISING_EDGE;
                    end else begin
                        next_state = IDLE;
                    end
                end
                
                FALLING_EDGE: begin
                    if (a == 0 && prev_a == 1) begin
                        next_state = FALLING_EDGE;
                    end else begin
                        next_state = IDLE;
                    end
                end
                
                default: next_state = IDLE;
            endcase
        end
        
        <assign rise = (current_state == RISING_EDGE) ? 1 : 0;
        <assign down = (current_state == FALLING_EDGE) ? 1 : 0;
    </logic_description>
    
    <implementation>Edge detection logic implemented using sequential logic blocks.</implementation>
</module>
